name: Don't Click The Flower
storyline:
Don't Click the Flower begins as a simple personality test.
You are asked a series of questions about your choices, your instincts, and the way you see the world. Each answer quietly shapes a profile that the game builds about you.

At first, everything feels straightforward. Just answer honestly and see what kind of person you are.
There is only one rule.

Don’t click the flower.

It seems harmless, almost trivial. But as the questions unfold, the game starts reacting to your decisions. Patterns appear. Certain answers seem to matter more than others. The narrator begins to notice things… about you.

Slowly, the test stops feeling like a simple questionnaire.
It begins to feel like something else.

The deeper you go, the more the game observes your behavior, your contradictions, and the way you justify your choices. It will build a profile based not only on what you say, but on how you act.

By the end, the game will reveal what it believes you truly are.

Whether you agree with it… is another question.
summary:
Don't Click the Flower is a narrative personality test where every choice matters.
Answer the questions… but remember the only rule: Don’t click the flower.
